meta.title: LocalFolio workbench suite
meta.description: Installs the LocalFolio incremental plugins in one go: per-plugin isolated storage, the /lf RPC and SSE gateway, the full-screen workbench with floating panels, and the My plugins section in DSH settings. The workbench layers over the native DSH UI without taking it over — Esc or Back to DSH returns you there — and writes only under %LOCALAPPDATA%/LocalFolio, never into DSH storage or session folders.
